bullets.text: Prime Minister Narendra Modi arrives in Chennai today following Rahul Gandhi's visit, creating a tense political atmosphere in Tamil Nadu that the office should closely monitor.
News18 Tamil Nadu is reporting live on major political developments involving Chief Minister Vijay, DMK, Congress, and BJP that the office must keep track of.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi will launch Chennai Metro Rail Phase 2 and share a ride with Chief Minister Vijay from Porur Bypass to Poonamallee.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi is visiting Chennai today on a one-day trip to launch development projects worth Rs 13,000 crore.
The Poonamallee to Vadapalani metro rail service schedule has been announced as operations begin today in Chennai.

stories.title: PM Modi to launch Chennai Metro Rail Phase 2, to share ride with Tamil Nadu CM Vijay
takeaways: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chief Minister Vijay launched Phase 2 metro services.
The first train from Porur Bypass to Poonamallee commenced operations after six years.
